purpose: Complete the research questions through a bounded independent environment replication, retaining the valid old S1/S2 evidence without repeating the old 936-request screening matrix.

selection_origin.classification: Old-data-informed targeted replication, prospectively frozen before its own measurements; not the original study preregistration and not a fresh oracle search.
selection_origin.candidate_identity_rule: Candidate requests and per-workload winners are copied from the old frozen S1 selection; workload priorities use already observed old S1/S2 and the old frozen headline/H2 choices. Only these identities and immutable source hashes are inputs. New times never reselect winners, directions, endpoints or rounds.
selection_origin.no_label_import: No old latency, R, guard validity, calibration, setup cost or observation enters any new pair, aggregate, test or amortization. Old S1/S2 remains a separate valid cohort; old S3 is interrupted, old S4 and the old separate H2 followup remain unperformed. This study does not complete or relabel those old stages.

source.instrumentation: Generated independent header overrides and a separate harness; record original and generated source hashes, patch manifest, binary SHA256.

scope.hardware_caps: Query the selected real device; do not override thread/shared-memory/warp caps or use fake pointers.
scope.cohort: New host, new UUID, new driver/toolchain and fresh process data; independent from all old-host datasets.

environment.cuda_policy: Use explicit CUDA 12.8 headers/libraries/toolchain, do not silently select installed 13.x. Record actual compiler, NVRTC/runtime/driver versions and paths.
environment.container_identity_probe: Root verified local CUDA-context PID equals nvidia-smi PID and context reset succeeds before this freeze; this was a no-kernel compatibility check, not a performance observation.
environment.build_freeze: Before the first equivalence process, record immutable instrumented/plain binary SHA256, unchanged original headers, generated headers/patch manifest, controller and guard hashes plus exact GPU/toolchain identity. These build hashes are filled only by artifact identity, before measuring effects. Any binary change after that stops the cohort pending a dated engineering record.

measurement.execution_metric: Median CUDA-event interval of a serialized graph containing R forward calls, divided by R. It is repeated immutable-input steady-state graph latency for this working set; not isolated-call latency or host API latency.
measurement.graph: Use actual start/stop graph event-record nodes on the single stream; each forward follows the previous forward's final nodes. For this bounded smooth1D matrix, require captured kernel count = R times numAxisUploads and exactly two external event nodes. A mismatch rejects the measurement rather than silently assuming the dispatch count; any later scope requiring split dispatches needs a separate measured R=1 baseline and protocol amendment.

repeats.calibration: Fresh default candidate only, target raw median interval >=0.5ms, cap2048, at most3 total probes including initial R=1. Adjustment may use ceil(1.1*target_ms/observed_per_fft_ms). Freeze the last actually measured R, retain below-target flags, and save all probes for every candidate and later remeasurement of that workload.
repeats.cap_flag: If cap prevents target, keep flagged result and quantify timer granularity; do not recalibrate on winners.

measurement.restore: Restore the same host input before each graph sample outside event timing; R calls within a graph reuse immutable input. Verify bitwise input stability after one call and repeated graph.
measurement.process_order: For each execution round, use the original deterministic workload_order helper under this new namespace, retaining only workloads whose frozen rounds exceed the round index. Default and replica bracket seeded-shuffled nondefault candidates; alternate baseline identity by round.
measurement.confirmation_order: All execution samples are 101; fresh process/context per candidate and round. Only process medians are independent replicates.
measurement.seed_derivation: SHA256(seed_namespace + ':' + phase + ':' + workload_id + ':' + round_index), first four bytes little-endian uint32. Same input seed within each paired block; phases equivalence, semantics/<pattern>, calibration, health, execution and cost are distinct.
measurement.repeats_import: Forbidden: calibrate only default on this new device with this new binary. Freeze last actually measured R separately for every declared calibration workload. Never import old R, timings, validity flags or process records.

calibration.rule: Fresh default candidate only, target raw median interval >=0.5ms, cap2048, at most3 total probes including initial R=1. Adjustment may use ceil(1.1*target_ms/observed_per_fft_ms). Freeze the last actually measured R, retain below-target flags, and save all probes for every candidate and later remeasurement of that workload.

preflight.cpu_reference: Retain the independent CPU FP64 direct-DFT reference self-test and criterion_v2 checks from the existing audited harness; record build/test results before GPU execution.

equivalence.pass_rule: All eight fresh processes pass numerical, immutable-input and graph checks. Match the same request across binaries by canonical semantics and ordered generated source hashes. Instrumented actual NVRTC options must match expected compiler inputs; plain actual compiler options remain explicitly unobserved. Original-header plain capture is post-initialize retained source, not a precompile describe path.
equivalence.performance_use: Excluded from all performance, selection, initialization-cost and hypothesis estimates.

semantic_probes.pass_rule: Every declared probe must pass criterion_v2, immutable-input, natural-order and repeated-graph checks. Any failure stops this stage for diagnosis; no candidate substitution or automatic repeat.
semantic_probes.performance_use: Excluded from all performance and hypothesis estimates.

health.criteria: All correctness/guard checks pass, all source/compiler fingerprints match within default/replica pairs, every pair abs(log(ratio))<=log(1.05), each workload ratio geometric mean in [0.98,1.02], and no process first/last quartile median drift above5% in either direction. No importing old health pairs.

statistics.unit: paired process median, never the101 graph samples
statistics.interval: ordinary paired-log Student-t95% interval shown as descriptive interval
statistics.test: one-sided paired-log Student-t; Holm correction across all predeclared directional benefit tests in the headline manifest
statistics.clear_gain: point geometric-mean ratio>=1.05 AND Holm-adjusted p<0.05 against the2% null, plus valid negative controls and guard
statistics.zero_variance: If paired-log range <=16*float64_epsilon*max(1,maxabs(logratios)), retain the point ratio as descriptive only, mark noninferential and show no t/p/CI; p=1 is a family-counting placeholder, not measured statistical evidence.
statistics.negative_control: default_replica comparisons are quality diagnostics, never benefit hypotheses and never counted as performance wins.
statistics.crossover_claim: Both opposing directions must independently satisfy clear_gain; otherwise exploratory reversal only.
statistics.scope: One new-cohort Holm family across the three H1 and two H2 directional benefit tests. No old-cohort test or timing enters it.
statistics.missing: Every frozen direction remains in the five-test family. Missing or invalid endpoints have no inferential effect/interval; use p=1 only for Holm counting. Never substitute a new candidate or direction.

crossover.claim: Both opposite directions must satisfy clear_gain in the same new five-test Holm family to claim the pair-specific reversal.

execution.noninferential_rows: The old-S1 winner at n16384_b1 and five three-round cost-support workloads provide same-environment execution and initialization components only. Default-winning workloads contribute controls and defined choice effect1, not benefit hypotheses. No additional significance tests are selected from these observations.
execution.control_rule: Use the original whole-block default/replica source,5% log-ratio and5%drift checks. The2%aggregate threshold belongs only to health. Any failed block stays excluded as a whole; no favorable-row retention.
execution.failure_rule: Any execution, numerical, guard or hard protocol failure stops this one-attempt stage and preserves all attempts for diagnosis. No old A5 local-failure continuation is activated and no automatic replacement is authorized.

cost_profile.context: One initialized CUDA primary context per pipeline process. Construct and destroy each candidate sequentially. Report context bootstrap separately; no binary-import cache in full construction. Do not sum separate-process initialization costs and call it same-context search.

pipelines.full: Construct all26 requests fully in the frozen candidate permutation, recording every span and cleanup. This is all-candidate construction cost; actual GPU benchmarking/search-decision cost is separate.
pipelines.describe_selected: Describe all26 in the identical permutation and cleanup each draft, then fully construct/destroy the frozen S1 winner. Winner is supplied from offline screening; label this a known-choice construction lower bound, not an online learned selection demonstration.

cost_profile.order: Pair the two pipeline modes within each workload/round; alternate mode order across rounds and seed candidate permutation by workload/round. Fresh process per pipeline, same context retained within it. Record the first and subsequent NVRTC/module operations.
cost_profile.accounting: Keep span ID/parent, monotonic start/end, inclusive and exclusive wall times. Sum exclusive categories for reconciliation; never sum overlapping inclusive times. Preserve unattributed residual. API host time is not necessarily device completion time; no artificial sync between every stage. Explicit final sync belongs to its own measured boundary.
cost_profile.cold_warm: Use 'fresh process/context, first operation' and 'later operation in same context'; do not claim OS/compiler/driver cache coldness. Record cache environment, CUDA/driver/NVRTC versions and compiler options.
cost_profile.describe_contract: Restricted smooth1D scope, layout and host codegen reused; skip CompileKernel and return before app tail temp allocation. Allowed LUT allocation/H2D must be timed and cleaned. Entire call chain compile/module-load/kernel-launch counts must all be zero. Reject auxiliary FFT paths before side effects.
cost_profile.equivalence: For every candidate on each fixed cost workload, compare describe vs full canonical value descriptor, ordered source hashes and compiler inputs. Ignore addresses/module handles and transient buffer-update flags. Confirm immutable original request (including batch and buffer capacities) is used on full reconstruction.
cost_profile.failure_policy: Any resource/monitor/identity failure, pipeline execution failure, trace/counter/schema/candidate-order protocol failure stops this stage with evidence retained. If both processes are protocol-clean but describe/full canonical/source equivalence or selected-materialization equality fails, retain it as a scientific H3 limitation and continue only the remaining fixed pairs. No replacement or extra cases.
outputs: absolute ms per stage and pipeline
fraction of full setup in compilation/loading vs other work
actual describe overhead and retained resource cost
all26 vs source-deduplicated hypothetical lower-bound counts, clearly separated
execution-count amortization using measured setup and execution deltas
cost_profile.amortization: Use only execution/default-initialization observations from this same new cohort. For each cost workload, average its paired default-minus-fixed-winner execution differences over all its prespecified execution rounds (10 or 3). If the winner is default the execution difference is zero by definition. No finite break-even when execution delta is nonpositive, missing or invalid.
cost_profile.first_pair: The predeclared n1024_b1 round 0 pair is both the first engineering path check and ordinary primary cost data under this identical protocol. Do not add a separate smoke pair, discard this first pair based on its timings, or replace it.

amortization_components.scope: Shared-context per-candidate initialization component; excludes all describe enumeration, context/setup/cleanup, benchmark search, scoring and fallback.

amortization_components.formula: mean_over_3_cost_rounds(sum(initialize_ms of all 26 describe apps plus one selected materialization)) - mean_over_new_execution_rounds(default.initialize_ms)
amortization_components.scope: Nonpaired initialization-component diagnostic across two stages on the same new environment. Includes work timed inside initialize_ms, including any timed LUT preparation; excludes outer context bootstrap, buffer/setup queries, cleanup outside initialize, scoring/validation/fallback. It is not an end-to-end default-planner comparison.

cost_profile.amortization_rule: For each explicitly labeled component, if setup components are complete and same-cohort execution_delta_ms>0, report ceil(max(0,setup_delta_ms)/execution_delta_ms), marking setup_delta<=0 as no extra initialization-component cost. Small/uncertain execution differences produce only a nominal diagnostic, never a guaranteed payoff or a new significance claim.
cost_profile.baseline_boundary: Current default VkFFT constructs one plan. Full26 versus describe26+known-choice1 compares exhaustive candidate construction with a known-choice construction component, not current default planning versus an online learner. One selected plan may require more than one NVRTC compilation when it has multiple uploads.

guard.foreign_compute: Any compute PID outside the verified process tree on the selected UUID invalidates the overlapping process, stops the run, and preserves evidence. Do not touch other users' processes.
guard.memory_cap_semantics: Predeclared total selected-GPU budget, including context and display baseline. An otherwise valid candidate exceeding it is resource-budget-ineligible; do not call it mathematically invalid. Record own allocations and total memory. No adaptive threshold based on timings.
guard.process_polling: Capture pre/post state plus periodic observations; state the finite polling blind spot. Instrumentation/driver errors are explicit.
guard.negative_control_gate: In every block require default and replica source/compiler-input fingerprints equal, and absolute log(default_median/replica_median) <= log(1.05). Any violation quarantines the whole block for review, never only the faster/slower row.
guard.drift_gate: If first- vs last-quartile sample median differs by >5% in either direction, flag the block as nonstationary; do not present its apparent winner as settled evidence.
guard.resume: One primary attempt per stage and no automatic retries. Preserve every partial/invalid/quarantined record. On resource, monitoring, identity, protocol or execution failure stop and diagnose; any later repair or rerun needs a separately recorded decision before new data, never a silent repeat.
guard.implementation: Use the independently reviewed retained-pidfd ownership proof and exact current-child identity checks. This cohort does not activate old A1-A6 recovery admissions. Freeze the deployed guard/controller hashes before launch. The 1s bounded owned-exit proof does not waive the 2s query limit or any foreign PID.

budgets.stop_after: One complete bounded cohort or a defined stop. Preserve all data, including interrupted and negative outcomes; no automatic host move, expanded grid, model, replacement pair or extra round.

reporting.cohort_separation: Keep old and new summaries, tests and denominators separate. Differences reflect a new environment (driver/toolchain/host/device instance), not an isolated causal hardware experiment. Do not pool process pairs, geometric means, cost differences or p-values across hosts.
reporting.H1: Report each frozen key-case ratio, confidence interval and five-test-family decision together with weak/null cases. These targeted workloads cannot estimate prevalence across all36 old workloads or general FFT workloads.
reporting.H2: Report exact candidate identities, both frozen batch endpoints, actual structures and the two joint family decisions. Batch changes working-set/cache conditions and available parallelism; no profiler-derived mechanism is claimed.
reporting.H3: Separate actual zero-compile/module/launch descriptor feasibility and full equivalence from measured construction cost. Show pipeline wall, context/setup/cleanup, exclusive stage totals and residuals, first/later compiler operations, actual NVRTC counts, and limited-scope amortization components. Source/class deduplication is a hypothetical reduction unless actually measured.
reporting.model_boundary: No new H4 training is performed. Few effective structures and many nominal aliases make deduplication and simple rules strong alternatives. Performance gaps and cheaper describe do not establish necessity or end-to-end benefit of a complex learner. Candidate legality still requires explicit constraints/validation and fallback; compiling one selected plan is not one guaranteed NVRTC call.
reporting.artifact_integrity: Record exact frozen design/hash, runtime binary/environment/controller manifest, candidate/per-workload identities, all raw records and guard logs, completed block/pair manifests, all numerical results and failures, source fingerprints and descriptive/inferential statistics. No old recovery files are prerequisites.
reporting.old_cohort_link: Link the separate old independent_s1_review.json and independent_s2_review.json as source-cohort evidence, explicitly retaining old S3 interrupted/S4 unperformed/H2 followup unperformed status.
